WITH ranked_wins AS (
  SELECT
    winner_id,
    winner_name,
    winner_rank,
    winner_age,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY winner_id
      ORDER BY winner_age, tourney_date, match_num
    ) AS rn
  FROM matches
  WHERE winner_age IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT winner_id, winner_name, winner_rank
FROM ranked_wins
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY winner_age
LIMIT 5;
